verdict.rationale: Importing data is a fair question for a managed Postgres service, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a path for bringing an existing production database into Neon. There is no import guide, dump/restore workflow, logical-replication migration or low-downtime cutover procedure. The schema-migration features (MCP 'Prepare/Complete Database Migration', Copilot migration agents on branches) cover schema changes within Neon, not importing an external database, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import an existing production database with minimal downtime using a documented migration path
